description: This source file provides utility functions and data structures related to graphics driver identification, including hardware ID checks, driver version comparisons, and platform-specific information retrieval, primarily for Intel graphics hardware within the ANGLE project.

classes.name: IntelDriverVersion
classes.description: Represents and compares Intel driver version numbers.

classes.name: OSVersion
classes.description: Encapsulates OS version information and comparison operators.

methods.name: operator==
methods.description: Checks equality of two IntelDriverVersion instances.

methods.name: operator!=
methods.description: Checks inequality of two IntelDriverVersion instances.

methods.name: operator<
methods.description: Compares if one IntelDriverVersion is less than another.

methods.name: operator>=
methods.description: Checks if one IntelDriverVersion is greater than or equal to another.

methods.name: IsIvyBridge
methods.description: Checks if a device ID corresponds to an Ivy Bridge GPU.

methods.name: IsHaswell
methods.description: Checks if a device ID corresponds to a Haswell GPU.

methods.name: IsBroadwell
methods.description: Checks if a device ID corresponds to a Broadwell GPU.

methods.name: IsCherryView
methods.description: Checks if a device ID corresponds to a CherryView GPU.

methods.name: IsSkylake
methods.description: Checks if a device ID corresponds to a Skylake GPU.

methods.name: IsBroxton
methods.description: Checks if a device ID corresponds to a Broxton GPU.

methods.name: IsKabylake
methods.description: Checks if a device ID corresponds to a Kabylake GPU.

methods.name: GetVendorString
methods.description: Returns vendor string based on vendor ID.

methods.name: GetAndroidSDKVersion
methods.description: Retrieves Android SDK version if on Android platform.

methods.name: OSVersion
methods.description: Constructor and comparison operators for OS version info.
